references.text: Describes the conquest of Lachish, which verse 35 refers to as the pattern for the destruction of Eglon
The continuation of the campaign against Lachish, which forms the basis for the comparison in verse 35
The same pattern of total destruction (herem) is used in the conquest of Hebron
Identical wording about striking the city with the edge of the sword and devoting it to banishment
The destruction of Jericho establishes the pattern for herem (banishment) used in Joshua's conquests
God's command to devote Canaanite cities to banishment (herem)
The law of herem requiring total destruction of Canaanite cities
Summary of how Joshua carried out the ban as Moses had commanded
